close_or_cancel_during_failure: No cancellation publication until a successful exact clear completion; original ownership remains held.
normal_success: value0 keeps existing response/cancellation semantics; publication failure retains claim; successful publication releases exactly once.
ownership_rule: Only proven successful Mirror.clear (value0) permits ending the exact in-kernel reservation. A valid negative result must preserve response claim and prevent normal or cancellation publication; a later exact successful completion may finish the retained reservation.
quarantine_policy: No new global quarantine requirement is invented by this ownership oracle.
repeated_finish: Negative retries retain one original claim; after successful finish no second completion or release.
untrusted_finish: Wrong worker/serial and out-of-range errno must not mutate the valid reservation or prevent its subsequent exact valid completion.
